card.name: Per-unit counting: one vial, each wafer
card.fires_on: The word or word ending right after "one", "1" or "each" plus a countable item (vial, wafer, applicator, pledget, bit). The next word is likely to be a "per each" idea such as "each" or "every".

modes.label: Single unit noun
modes.description: Name of a single package or item after one/1/each, such as vial, wafer or applicator.

modes.label: Verb after one item
modes.description: Verb right after "One [item]" before a statement of how much it covers.
modes.example: One applicator<< is>> normally sufficient for each application.

modes.label: Unit equivalence
modes.description: Unit after 1 in a conversion or a per-item definition.

card.writes: Promotes words meaning "each" or "every" in several languages, which fits a per-unit statement coming next.
card.plain: It fires after "one" plus an item, such as one vial or one applicator, when the text is about to say what each one does or equals.
